question: Who was the first Secretary-General of the United Nations Organization (UNO)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Trygve Lie**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Norwegian lawyer and politician Trygve Lie was the **United Nations** first Secretary-General.
 
• He held the post for seven years, from 1946 to 1953, and was a Norwegian politician, labour leader, government official and author. 
 
• The **United Nations **is an intergovernmental organization whose stated purposes are **to maintain international peace and security, develop friendly** **relations** among nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5e1400ae1759de4882ebcccddc358f5016e986c6e76fce364a11d499e2d4fc8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dag Hammarskjöld**** **was a Swedish economist and diplomat who served as **the second Secretary-General **of the United Nations.
 
• **U Thant, **was a Burmese diplomat and the **third secretary-general of the United Nations from 1961 to 1971**, the first non-Scandinavian to hold the position. 

 
• **Kurt Josef Waldheim** was an Austrian politician and diplomat. Waldheim was the** fourth Secretary-General** of the United Nations.
